Define the compound set as CHEMBL1173655 (Afatinib) plus all its salts by joining molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno matching the parent compound's molregno, including the parent row itself. Retrieve activity provenance through the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Filter to activities where standard_type is IC50, standard_units is nM, and target chembl_id is CHEMBL203. LEFT JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Derive pubmed_id_or_doi as COALESCE(pubmed_id, doi) from docs. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not limit rows.
